units.source_text: 当夫人面对镜子的时候，

en.t: When the lady faced the mirror,

units.source_text: 小宠犬花花公子一如既往地跳上修指甲的化妆桌，

en.t: the little pet dog, Playboy, jumped as usual onto the manicure dressing table,

units.source_text: 蹲坐在桌上置放的洋式小棉坐垫上，

en.t: settled down on the small Western-style cotton cushion placed on the table,

units.source_text: 歪着小脑袋聚精会神地瞧着夫人化妆。

en.t: and watched the lady put on her makeup with its little head tilted, utterly absorbed.

units.source_text: 它那神态活像一个口齿伶俐的姑娘在催促着：

en.t: Its expression was just like a quick-tongued girl urging her on:
Hurry up and put makeup on me.

units.source_text: 小宠犬在修指甲的化妆桌上被梳理毛发，

en.t: When the little pet dog had its fur groomed on the manicure dressing table,

units.source_text: 它不仅感觉这是一种化妆，

en.t: it not only felt that this was a kind of makeup,

units.source_text: 甚至能够通过这种化妆的方式知道它交配的日期。

en.t: but could even tell the date of its mating by the way this makeup was done.

units.source_text: 因为在它交配日这天早晨，

en.t: For on the morning of its mating day,

units.source_text: 夫人总会格外精心地给它化妆。

en.t: the lady would always make it up with exceptional care.
